project_name: VoxShield – Real-Time WebRTC Audio Deepfake & Voice Impersonation Detector
persona: E1 Creative Designer - High Impact Forensic Audio Security Dashboard

layout.app_shell: min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-[#5fe3d8] via-[#6be9df] to-[#7af0e6] p-3 md:p-6 font-sans antialiased text-slate-800

header.title: VoxShield
header.subtitle: Real-Time WebRTC Audio Deepfake and Voice Impersonating Forensic Detector
features: Shield Logo Icon with Aqua Glow

sidebar.style: Rounded sidebar container in deep teal (#11847c) with inner glow, bottom layered wave graphic decorations, dark active pill states.

dynamic_island.description: Floating pill dynamic island component that transforms out from top center/microphone position when audio capture begins.
states: Expanded: Showing recording timer (00:14 / 00:30), active mic wave pulse, input source badge (Speaker Output vs Microphone), and instant Stop button
Minimised: Sleek pill header status showing live pitch frequency in Hz and animated audio bars

center_top_card.name: Live Audio Detection
elements: Pulsing aqua/teal circular mic graphic with concentric sound arcs and expanding ripple animation
Listening... status pulse indicator
Symmetrical audio spectrum bars moving in real time to speech input
Action Pill Buttons: 'Capture Speaker Output' (Tab/System audio via WebRTC) & 'Use Microphone'
Audio stream config pill (Sample Rate: 48kHz, PCM 16-bit, Latency: 42ms)

center_bottom_card.name: Live Audio Waveform & Pitch Analyser
elements: Real-Time Waveform visualizer canvas with gradient line (Teal to Mint)
Pitch Analyser graph displaying live F0 fundamental frequency curve (Hz vs Time)
Audio Timer readout (e.g. 00:12 / 00:30)
Skeleton Loading state trigger while AI model computes packet forensic vectors

right_top_card.name: Detection Result
elements: Circular score gauge with percentage ring (0-100% Deepfake risk)
Primary Verdict Badge: 'AUTHENTIC VOICE' (Green Shield Check) or 'SYNTHETIC DEEPFAKE' (Red Alert)
Forensic Metric Breakdown Bars:
- Deepfake Probability (e.g. 2%)
- Impersonation Probability (e.g. 3%)
- Audio Confidence Score (e.g. 98%)
- Signal Quality Status (Good / High SNR)
AI Spectral Jitter & Shimmer Micro-Metrics

right_bottom_card.name: Activity Log
elements: Live scrolling timestamped forensic events
Color-coded status dots (Green = Verified Human, Red = Voice Synthetic Detection, Yellow = Noise Warning)
View All logs button opening drawer modal

login_page.background: Deep dark slate background with 'Peak Audio Wave' ambient canvas animation

totp_2fa.title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
totp_2fa.description: Enter the 6-digit TOTP code from your authenticator app (Google Authenticator / Authy) or scan setup QR code.

features: Filterable table/grid of past audio analysis sessions
Audio Player component with sample playback and highlighted waveform anomaly zones
Verdict status pills (Authentic / Deepfake Detected / Impersonation Risk)

animations.mic_ripple: Infinite pulsing concentric rings around microphone icon using absolute ping layers
animations.dynamic_island_spring: Framer Motion layout transition scaling top island pill smooth spring physics
animations.login_peak_waves: Canvas/SVG animated sine peaks bouncing to ambient synth frequency
animations.skeleton_shimmer: Custom skeleton pulse shimmer overlay over result metrics while audio packet analyzing

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_requirement: EVERY interactive element, button, link, gauge, audio trigger, login input, TOTP field MUST have data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

Ensure background gradient uses aqua/turquoise tones (#5fe3d8 to #7af0e6).
Implement the Dynamic Island floating bar at top center when audio capture starts.
Implement pitch analyzer chart (F0 frequency plot) alongside the waveform visualizer.
